description: Kubernetes only. CloudNativePG cluster health: instances, roles, connections, replication lag, WAL archiving, backups, locks and checkpoints from the cnpg_* metrics.

panels.title: Navigation
panels.description: Links to the other Time Manager dashboards. The alert rules live under Alerting > Alert rules.

panels.title: Instances up
panels.description: Instances of the cluster whose CloudNativePG metrics collector answers (cnpg_collector_up). Should equal the number of instances in the Cluster spec.

panels.title: Primary
panels.description: Instances that are not in recovery. Exactly one is expected; 0 means no writable primary (failover in progress), 2 or more means split brain.

panels.title: Replicas
panels.description: Instances in recovery (streaming standbys).

panels.title: Connections used
panels.description: Busiest instance: open backends as a share of its max_connections. Alert above 80%.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of block reads served from shared buffers. Healthy OLTP stays above 99%.

panels.title: Last backup age
panels.description: Time since the last successful base backup (cnpg_collector_last_available_backup_timestamp). Shows the epoch distance when no backup exists yet.

panels.title: Deadlocks (range)
panels.description: Deadlocks detected in the selected range.

panels.title: Instance role
panels.description: 1 = primary (not in recovery), 0 = replica. A change of the series that sits at 1 is a switchover or failover.

panels.title: Connections vs max_connections
panels.description: Open backends per instance against its max_connections setting.

panels.title: Transactions per second
panels.description: Commits and rollbacks per second on the whole cluster.

panels.title: Connections by state
panels.description: Backends by state (active, idle, idle in transaction) summed over the cluster.

panels.title: Longest open transaction
panels.description: Age of the oldest transaction per instance: values that keep growing indicate leaked connections.

panels.title: Waiting backends
panels.description: Backends waiting on a lock, per instance.

panels.title: Replication lag per replica
panels.description: Seconds each replica is behind the primary (cnpg_pg_replication_lag, reported by the standbys).

panels.title: Lag seen from the primary
panels.description: Write, flush and replay lag per streaming standby, measured by the primary (pg_stat_replication).

panels.title: Streaming replicas
panels.description: Standbys connected to the primary, against the replicas whose WAL receiver is up.

panels.title: WAL archive backlog
panels.description: WAL segments waiting to be archived (ready) and already archived (done) per instance. A growing ready count means archiving is failing and the volume will fill up.

panels.title: WAL archiver activity
panels.description: Segments archived and archive failures per second.

panels.title: Last backup age over time
panels.description: Time since the last available base backup; the line should saw-tooth back to zero after each scheduled backup.

panels.title: Time since last archival
panels.description: Seconds since the last WAL segment was archived, on the primary. Idle clusters switch WAL every archive_timeout.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio over time
panels.description: Buffer cache hit ratio per database.

panels.title: Locks by mode
panels.description: Locks currently held per lock mode, summed over the cluster.

panels.title: Deadlocks and conflicts
panels.description: Deadlocks and recovery conflicts per second.

panels.title: Rows per second
panels.description: Tuples returned, fetched, inserted, updated and deleted per second.

panels.title: Temp bytes
panels.description: Temporary files spilled to disk (work_mem too small) per second.

panels.title: Checkpoints per second
panels.description: Timed checkpoints versus requested ones: many requested checkpoints mean max_wal_size is too small for the write load. Works for PostgreSQL 16 (bgwriter) and 17+ (checkpointer).

panels.title: Checkpoint write and sync time
panels.description: Milliseconds per second spent writing and syncing files during checkpoints.

panels.title: Buffers written
panels.description: Buffers written per second by the background writer, by checkpoints and directly by backends (backends only on PostgreSQL 16).

panels.title: Database size over time
panels.description: Growth of each database on disk (the primary and replicas report the same size).

title: Time Manager - PostgreSQL (CloudNativePG)
